senses.gloss: m.(b. h. כֹּפֶר; כָּפַר)indemnity, fine; [atonement.] B. Kam. IV, 5 משלם כ׳ must pay indemnity for a life lost.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 40a:15">Ib. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>חצי כ׳</he> half the assessed fine.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 40a:16">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ שלם אמר רחמנא וכ׳</he> the law (<cite ref="Exodus 21:30">Ex. XXI, 30</cite>) speaks of a full indemnity (as an atonement) &c., v. <cite ref="K00346">next w.</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 21:4">Treat. Sof’rim XXI, 4</cite> <he>לשם כ׳</he> as an obligatory ransom, opp. <he>לשם נדבה</he>.—Pl. <he>כּוֹפְרִין</he>. B. Kam. l. c. <he>חייבי כ׳ מאי</he> how is it about seizing the property of those bound to pay indemnities?; a. fr.
